title: S6 position-keeper — API surface
description: Port 7660, prefix POS-. Endpoints (from router): GET /healthz, /readyz, /positions, /positions/{symbol}, /positions/snapshot, /history/{symbol}, /stats; POST /adjust; POST /corporate-action. Positions are keyed by (account, symbol). Fills are ingested exactly-once (idempotency set) from S4 /fills.

adjustRequest.description: POST /adjust — a manual operator correction. AdjustmentRecord.from_dict. Required: symbol, delta_qty (non-zero). account defaults to the configured default_account. new_avg_price is optional (>= 0) for cost-basis rebases.

delta_qty.description: Signed quantity change; must be non-zero.

new_avg_price.description: Optional cost-basis rebase; absent => keep existing average.

corporateActionRequest.description: POST /corporate-action — a corporate action reshaping every non-flat position of a symbol. CorporateAction.from_dict. Required: type (SPLIT|DIVIDEND), symbol. SPLIT requires factor > 0; DIVIDEND requires per_share >= 0.

per_share.description: DIVIDEND only; cash per lot, >= 0. Default 0.0.

position.description: A PositionState row (to_dict with ref_price). Appears in /positions, /positions/{symbol}, /positions/snapshot.

net_qty.description: Signed net position (positive long, negative short).

unrealized_pnl.description: Present when a ref price is known.
